summary: Broad relief rally: all indices green, VIX -12.82% to 15.44, but 5day/20day trends still Down and RUT/DJI regimes Bearish. Semiconductors (INTC +7.67%, XSD +4.06%) and precious metals (SIL +4.49%) led; software and telecom sold in a hardware/hard-asset rotation. Oversold bounce over unrepaired downtrend.
